name: leading-source-registry
purpose: Discover A-share opportunities from leading physical, transactional and operating evidence before sell-side research becomes consensus.
principle: Discovery is led by observable state changes. Sell-side research is downstream expectation/valuation evidence, never the primary discovery engine.

sourcePriority.name: transactional_physical_leading
examples: Shanghai Shipping Exchange: SCFI/SCFIS/CCFI and bulk freight indices
Commodity exchanges: SHFE/DCE/CZCE/GFEX warehouse receipts, inventory, positions and settlement data
General Administration of Customs: monthly preliminary releases, HS commodity quantity/value/unit-value indices
China Government Procurement Network and sector procurement platforms: tender intentions, tender notices, awards and contract announcements
Power/energy operating data: NEA electricity consumption, installed capacity, grid/power investment; exchange/grid procurement where auditable
Auto high-frequency: industry association weekly/monthly retail, wholesale, export and inventory data
Construction machinery: excavator/loader monthly sales and export data
Agriculture: hog prices, breeding sow capacity, feed prices, slaughter and inventory data
Freight/logistics: route freight, port throughput, tanker/container/bulk indices
Company product price lists, order wins, monthly operating announcements and verified channel/booking data
sourcePriority.use: Trigger new economic-state candidates before narrative consensus forms.

sourcePriority.name: issuer_operating_primary
examples: CNINFO/exchange filings
issuer IR records and earnings-call materials
performance forecasts/pre-announcements
order/backlog/tender wins
contract liabilities, inventory, cash conversion, capex and utilization disclosures
sourcePriority.use: Map the L0 state change into direct listed-company economics using the latest already-available baseline; do not wait for a new quarter if an older baseline is still decision-valid.

sourcePriority.name: specialist_industry
examples: TrendForce for memory/display/PV/battery/components
SMM for metals and energy-transition materials
Mysteel for steel/coal/ore/construction chains
卓创资讯/隆众资讯 for chemicals, energy and agricultural pricing/operating rates
Counterpoint/IDC/Omdia/Canalys for consumer electronics and computing
Drewry/Freightos/Clarksons/Kpler/Vortexa where accessible for shipping/energy flow
industry associations for retail, autos, machinery, chemicals, medicine and logistics
sourcePriority.use: Confirm that the L0 observation is broad, persistent and economically causal rather than a noisy local print.

sourcePriority.name: high_quality_news
examples: Reuters
Bloomberg/FT/WSJ where accessible
财新/第一财经/证券时报/中国证券报/上海证券报
official ministry press conferences and regulator releases
sourcePriority.use: Explain why the physical state changed, discover policy/geopolitical triggers, and search contradictions. News does not replace the underlying data if direct data exist.

sourcePriority.name: sell_side_research
examples: Original broker research from major Chinese and global institutions
Eastmoney/Sina/10jqka only as transport/index layers to locate the original research
sourcePriority.use: Measure consensus earnings, estimate revisions, valuation, crowdedness and counter-theses after a candidate already exists. Never count the existence of a bullish report as a discovery signal.

sourcePriority.name: community_weak_signals
examples: 雪球/Reddit/industry forums/social media
job postings, supplier/customer chatter and user discussions when legally/publicly accessible
sourcePriority.use: Generate search directions only. No selection may rely on L5 without independent L0-L3 verification.

sourceScoring.rule: A source with lower prestige but materially earlier direct physical evidence can outrank a later research report for discovery.

weeklyWorkflow: 1. L0 broad scan by required family; record explicit no-change/unavailable states so coverage is auditable.
2. Cluster new state changes and compare them with prior-week baselines.
3. Use L1 existing company baselines to map beneficiaries/losers immediately; do not wait for a new report if exposure and economics are already sufficiently known.
4. Use L2/L3 to cross-check persistence, causality and contradictions.
5. Only after candidate mapping, query L4 research to estimate consensus/valuation and test whether the signal is already crowded.
6. Apply unchanged timing, price-absorption, quality and opportunity-cost gates.
antiLateRules: A sell-side report cannot be the first evidence item that creates an event cluster unless no earlier primary/physical source exists and the report contains unique independently verifiable data.
If a research report arrives after the stock has materially rerated, it is expectation/crowding evidence, not bullish confirmation.
When L0 reveals a new state and the selected company has a recent decision-valid L1 baseline, the system must re-underwrite immediately rather than wait for the next quarterly report.
A candidate discovered only after late L4 confirmation must be flagged evidence_latency_risk.
